analysis.object_evidence_protocol: OBJECT_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL defines composite scoring, pass_threshold=0.97, and hero_prop role gate; collection plan binds batch execution order without generating records.
analysis.object_dataset: OBJECT_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_DATASET provides easy/medium/hard/stress and role batch seeds for collection plan wiring.
analysis.object_reference_bank: Bank entries (suitcase_001, chair_014, lantern_001, wooden_crate_001) supply reference_bank_id and identity_signature templates.
analysis.object_similarity_binding: object_similarity_v1 same_object_threshold=0.97 governs object_classification assignment in record spec.
analysis.object_role_binding: object_role_v1 assigns hero_prop > scene_prop priority; hero_prop_batch runs with strictest pass threshold.
analysis.object_traceability_binding: traceability_signature links conditioning_map_ref and OBJECT_REFERENCE_BANK_SPECIFICATION for batch audit.

evidence_collection_contract.scope: Collection execution definition only — Collection Ready != Collection Executed.
evidence_collection_contract.gpu_execution: false — collection plan and record spec only; no evidence records generated.
evidence_collection_contract.texture_match_note: Texture Match is part of Object Identity — texture_match is a required classification_reason.
evidence_collection_contract.assessment_note: Do NOT claim OBJECT_EVIDENCE_COLLECTED, OBJECT_VALIDATED, or OBJECT_IDENTITY_READY.

collection_batch_plan.collection_order: easy_batch → medium_batch → hard_batch → stress_batch → hero_prop_batch → secondary_prop_batch → background_object_batch
collection_batch_plan.batch_note: Role batches run after difficulty batches; hero_prop_batch has highest failure risk.

collection_traceability_rules.record_traceability: Each evidence record must bind object_id, reference_bank_id, identity_signature, and traceability_signature.
collection_traceability_rules.batch_audit_signature: Collection batch_id hashes case_id list for offline replay without GPU execution.
collection_traceability_rules.classification_audit: object_classification and classification_reason required on every record at collection time.
collection_traceability_rules.role_binding_cross_ref: role_match classification_reason must align with hero_prop/secondary_prop/background_object batch tier.
collection_traceability_rules.collection_note: Collection Ready != Collection Executed; Evidence Records Generated = 0.
